scope: Independently reconstructed Python sqlite3 harness with the same 12 original synthetic excerpts, 14 fixed qrels and FTS5/LIKE SQL policies. Not an execution of the exact committed scripts/fixture bytes; not CI or production.

environment.cache: warm sequential, single process, no concurrency

limits: Results are from separately reconstructed local code and must be rerun using GitHub benchmark_lexical.py before an integration-grade performance claim
Build cost and latency are highly sensitive to machine/warm cache
Combined SQLite file size includes the plain document table and FTS index; not standalone index size
12 document snippets and 14 short queries are too few for production choice
LIKE and tokenized BM25 have materially different substring/morphology matching semantics
Aliases such as fiber concurrency versus virtual threads fail without a curated synonym strategy
Neither Lucene/Elasticsearch nor vector search was executed
No actual Tycho chapter index has been built
